caption: SurvTD replaces divergent unit-step survival consistency updates with a contractive renewal shift and categorical projection, eliminating division blow-up and suppressing clinical alarm fatigue under irregular telemetry.

panels.title: The Mathematical Mechanism: Division Divergence vs. Renewal Mixture

prior_methods.name: Prior Consistency (TCSR, DeepTCSR)
prior_methods.behavior: As patient risk rises (S -> 0), dividing by interval survival diverges to infinity (vertical asymptote), collapsing target distribution predictions into an uninformative flat line.

survtd.name: SurvTD (Ours)
survtd.formula: (1 - gamma_j) * mu + gamma_j * (Pi Phi_{+Delta t} p)
survtd.behavior: Reframes transition as an additive renewal shift in remaining lifetime (Phi) composed with categorical projection (Pi) and convex survival mixture (gamma_j = S(Delta t)). Strictly contractive, mass-conserving, with zero division instability.

panels.title: The Clinical Consequence: ICU Bedside Alarm Jittering
panels.x_axis: Elapsed ICU Hours (Irregular Sampling Intervals Delta t_j)
panels.y_axis: Predicted Remaining Lifetime / Shock Risk Score

traces.name: Unregularized Baseline (Dynamic-DeepHit)
traces.style: Dotted red line, high-frequency oscillations crossing the clinical alarm threshold repeatedly (14 false alert trigger episodes).

traces.name: Discrete Consistency Baseline (DeepTCSR with clamped division)
traces.style: Dashed orange line, erratic gradient spikes and collapse towards flat prediction at high-risk epochs.

traces.name: SurvTD (Ours)
traces.style: Solid navy blue line with 95% bootstrap confidence band, demonstrating smooth monotonic risk revision with only 2 sustained clinical alerts (78% reduction in alert jitter at matched 0.30 PPV).

takeaway: Unit-step division causes numerical instability and alarm fatigue; SurvTD's renewal projection guarantees contractive stability and actionable, calm bedside alerting.
